sentences.en: Agriculture is vulnerable to weather and climate variability.
sentences.zh: 农业容易受到天气和气候可变性的影响。

sentences.en: Herbal supplements sold in drugstores have poor quality control and high content variability.
sentences.zh: 药店出售的保健品质量控制差，成分可变性高。

sentences.en: Farmers have to get used to dealing with the variability of the weather.
sentences.zh: 农民必须习惯应对天气的可变性。

senses.zh: 变化性，易变，变化的倾向,变率
